description: Read the BRANDED SWAP DOOR's state: whether it is off or dry, the fee (none), its caps, the four NET pools and eight pairs it serves with their sources and what was NOT READ (the buying in NET's pools is the house's own), whether any reward for swaps is offered (none is paid) and counts of swaps wallets say they sent. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. It shows no wallet, no id and no transaction hash, and there is no list by wallet. It says plainly that the door does not sign, hold, advise or promise, that neither the live quote provider nor the independent reference reader is built, and that a recorded swap is the wallet's own statement and reads unverified. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.
name: net_swap_status
title: Where the swap door stands: its state, fee, caps, pairs and counts
